description: Style a table's or report's columns: font size (px), font family, text and background colour, bold, italic, underline, strike — for the chosen fields (property_ids; empty = all columns), on every row (all=true) or only on rows that match conditions (all=false + conditions). Use it for «make the font in field X smaller / larger», «make X bold / red», «highlight the rows where …». It shows in the table view; the form editor has no per-field font size. ⚠️ The rule's name is its key within the form: a call with the same name REWRITES that rule (status: updated), it does not add a second one — give a second rule another name.

all.description: true = every row, false = only rows that match the conditions

conditions.description: Conditions (when all=false). A condition is one of: is, is_not, is_empty, is_not_empty, starts_with, ends_with, like, contains, not_contains, less_than, greater_than, less_than_or_equal_to, greater_than_or_equal_to, between, after, before, this_day_and_after, this_day_and_before, last_7_days, last_30_days, last_60_days, last_90_days, last_120_days, next_7_days, next_30_days, next_60_days, next_90_days, next_120_days, this_year, last_year, next_year, last_2_years, next_2_years, current_and_prev_year, current_and_next_year, next_n_years, last_n_years, today, tomorrow, yesterday, today_or_later, before_today, last_week, this_week, next_week, current_and_prev_week, current_and_next_week, next_n_weeks, last_n_weeks, this_month, next_month, last_month, current_and_prev_month, current_and_next_month, next_n_months, last_n_months, next_n_days, last_n_days. On a date field «before», «after», «this_day_and_before», «this_day_and_after» and «between» compare with a FIXED date written in search — they do not move with the calendar; the ones that do take no search value: before_today (earlier than today — «overdue», «expired», «late»), today, yesterday, tomorrow, today_or_later and the last_… / next_… / this_… periods. Never write today's date or the word «today» into search.

criteria_name.description: The conditions in words (e.g. 'Amount over 1000'). Required when all=false.

entity_id.description: ID of the form or report

property_ids.description: Names or IDs of the fields the style applies to (empty = all columns)

settings.description: The style: background_color (#hex), text_color (#hex), bold, italic, underline, strike (boolean), font_family, font_size (a number of px), all_columns (boolean)

name: create_formatting
